shortDescription: Information module for Network Device Images Validation Results

options.name: catalystcenter_debug
options.description: Flag for Cisco Catalyst Center SDK to enable debugging.

options.name: catalystcenter_password
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center password to authenticate.

options.name: catalystcenter_username
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center username to authenticate.

options.name: catalystcenter_verify
options.description: Flag to enable or disable SSL certificate verification.

options.name: catalystcenter_version
options.description: Informs the SDK which version of Cisco Catalyst Center to use.

options.name: id
options.description: Id query parameter. Unique identifier of network device validation task.

options.name: limit
options.description: Limit query parameter. The number of records to show for this page. The minimum and maximum values are 1 and 500, respectively.

options.name: networkDeviceId
options.description: NetworkDeviceId query parameter. Network device identifier.

options.name: offset
options.description: Offset query parameter. The first record to show for this page; the first record is numbered 1. The minimum value is 1.

options.name: operationType
options.description: OperationType query parameter. The operation type, as part of which this validation will get triggered. Available values DISTRIBUTION, ACTIVATION, READINESS_CHECK.

options.name: order
options.description: Order query parameter. Whether ascending or descending order should be used to sort the response. Available values asc, desc.

options.name: sortBy
options.description: SortBy query parameter. A property within the response to sort by.

options.name: status
options.description: Status query parameter. Status of the validation result. SUCCESS, FAILED, IN_PROGRESS, WARNING.

options.name: type
options.description: Type query parameter. Type of the validation. Available values PRE_VALIDATION, POST_VALIDATION.

options.name: validate_response_schema
options.description: Flag for Cisco Catalyst Center SDK to enable the validation of request bodies against a JSON schema.
